title: "François Guizot and Henriette de Witt - L'histoire de France depuis les temps les plus reculés jusqu'en 1789, racontée à mes petits-enfants"
book_id: 802

## Publication Information

**Date:** 1870-1876

**Imprint:** Paris: Hachette

**Notes:** The fifth volume was completed by Henriette de Witt from her father's notes.  In 1878-9 she published a further two volumes, taking the history to 1848.
